sentences.en: Squash, vanilla beans, and yams are the main crops.
sentences.zh: 1. 冬瓜、香草豆和山药是主要作物。

sentences.en: Watermelon, okra, yams, black-eyed peas and some peppers are all indigenous to Africa.
sentences.zh: 2. 西瓜、秋葵、山药、黑眼豌豆以及一些辣椒都是非洲的原生植物。

sentences.en: For Thanksgiving dinner, we roasted sweet potatoes and yams.
sentences.zh: 感恩节晚餐，我们烤了红薯和山药。
